ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio; approximately 90% high-intensity white pixels to 10% low-intensity black pixels localized to the perimeter and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous white expanse occupying the majority of the fluke surface; bounded by a thin, irregular black perimeter along the trailing edge; secondary small reddish-brown focal spots present in the lower-left quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees; depth is significant, penetrating roughly 8% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern; approximately 18-22 distinct peaks and valleys identified across the trailing boundary with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a predominantly horizontal linear trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct, high-contrast textured clusters of brown and white pixels (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme lateral tips of the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A singular, short, reddish-brown linear pixel disruption oriented horizontally in the lower-central region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle clusters at distal tips; minor dark pigmented spotting on the ventral white surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical high-intensity pixel streaks below both distal tips, indicating water runoff.
